# Card disputes
## Raising a dispute
If you do not recognise a card transaction, raise a dispute within 120 days of the transaction date. We need the transaction date, amount and merchant name.
## Provisional credit
For a valid dispute, provisional credit is posted within five working days while the card network investigates.
## Chargeback outcome
The chargeback investigation takes up to 45 days. If the dispute is not upheld, the provisional credit is reversed with notice.
